environment.description: Same Terraform provider binary deployed in an environment where the LDAP bind credential's private key component is held exclusively within a Thales Luna Network HSM 7 (firmware 7.8.2) partition configured with FIPS 140-2 Level 3 policy. The LDAP connection uses SASL/EXTERNAL with mutual TLS where the client certificate's signing operation is performed via PKCS#11 calls to the HSM partition (slot 3). The HSM partition has a Partition Security Officer policy that restricts the bound identity (via the certificate subject CN mapped to an LDAP ACL) to ONLY perform search operations with a pre-registered filter template stored in the HSM's partition user-defined attributes (UDA). The OpenLDAP server's slapd.conf includes an ACL rule: 'access to * by dn.exact="cn=terraform-svc,ou=services,dc=corp,dc=example,dc=com" search ssf=256 filter="(&(objectClass=groupOfNames)(cn=*))"' which restricts the service identity to searches matching only that specific filter pattern. Additionally, the Luna HSM partition's challenge-response authentication requires a PED key (orange) physically present, and the partition policy bit 15 (Partition Policy: Allow non-extractable key operations only) ensures the TLS client key never leaves the HSM boundary.

config.hsm: Thales Luna Network HSM 7, firmware 7.8.2, FIPS 140-2 Level 3, partition policy bit 15 set
config.ldap_auth: SASL/EXTERNAL mutual TLS, client cert signed by HSM-held key, subject CN=terraform-svc
config.ldap_acl: slapd ACL restricts cn=terraform-svc to search-only with ssf=256 and filter template (&(objectClass=groupOfNames)(cn=*))
config.ldap_server: OpenLDAP 2.6.3 with overlays: constraint, ppolicy, accesslog; ssf minimum 256
config.network: mTLS required, certificate pinning on both ends via HSM-anchored CA
